requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C1 - verified written prosecutorial consent, joinder or signed consent endorsement
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C1 - verified written prosecutorial consent, joinder or signed consent endorsement
requiredBeforeFiling.why: CLD-2026-08-28-GA-RFO and the effective route record make written prosecutorial consent a prerequisite that must exist before filing
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: Attach the verified written prosecutorial consent, joinder or signed consent endorsement held as a document; do not file this petition without it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C2 - court and county in which the conviction was entered
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C2 - court and county in which the conviction was entered
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record requires the court of conviction and makes that court the filing destination
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: The court of conviction and its county, copied from the original criminal record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Original criminal case number in the caption
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Original criminal case number in the caption
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record says the default docket is the original criminal case
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: The original criminal case number, copied from the court record; use an ancillary number only if the receiving clerk requires one

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C3 - original judgment, sentence and disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C3 - original judgment, sentence and disposition
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record names these as required facts and packet records
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: The original judgment, sentence and disposition, copied from verified court records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C4 - original First Offender eligibility
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C4 - original First Offender eligibility
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record makes original First Offender eligibility a required fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: Whether the participant was eligible for First Offender treatment at the time, supported by the applicable evidence

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record names the applicable § 42-8-66 branch as a required fact
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: The applicable § 42-8-66 branch and the evidence supporting it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C6 - prior felony or prior First Offender history
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C6 - prior felony or prior First Offender history
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record names this history as a required fact and directs uncertain history out of self-help
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: Any prior felony or prior First Offender history, supported by verified records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C7 - qualifying order status and date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C7 - qualifying order status and date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the effective route record branches an already-granted order away from a second merits petition
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: Whether a qualifying order has already been granted and, if so, its date, copied from a verified record

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the person named in the caption, on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: the participant signs personally; this build never signs for anyone

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the petition
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the document is signed would be false
